name: qspice-mcp
description: Professional MCP server for the QSpice circuit simulator.
long_description: QSpice MCP lets an MCP client author and edit `.qsch` schematics, build DLL/C-block devices, generate netlists, run simulations, and read bounded waveform summaries against a local QSpice install. The `.qsch` file is the source of truth; netlists, logs, and `.qraw` waveforms are derived artifacts. Ships clean-room schematic and waveform fallbacks plus a bundled topology knowledge pack and reference recipes.

qspice_exe.title: QSPICE64.exe path
qspice_exe.description: Absolute path to the QSpice executable (QSPICE64.exe). Required for netlist generation and simulation.

workspace_root.title: Simulation workspace
workspace_root.description: Folder that holds your .qsch schematics and derived artifacts. All tool file access is sandboxed to this folder.

session_mode.title: Session mode
session_mode.description: cold always cold-launches a fresh simulation; auto reuses an available live-GUI session first.
